properties.name: Göbekli Tepe
properties.description: World's oldest known temple (11,600 years old), predating agriculture. Massive carved pillars depicting animals in ritual context.
properties.modernStatus: UNESCO World Heritage Site, ongoing excavation

properties.name: Orkhon Valley
properties.description: Sacred valley of the ancient Turks and Mongols. Contains the Orkhon inscriptions — oldest known Turkic writing. Capital of the Göktürk, Uighur, and Mongol empires.

properties.name: Selimiye Mosque (Edirne)
properties.description: Mimar Sinan's masterpiece, the pinnacle of Ottoman architecture. Dome surpasses Hagia Sophia. Represents celestial harmony in form.
properties.modernStatus: UNESCO World Heritage Site, active mosque
